subject: [PATCH v3 0/3] mm: split underused anonymous mTHP folios

2026-10-30.patch_summary: This patch series addresses memory regressions caused by 2M THP=always on arm64 by allowing the underused shrinker to handle anonymous mTHP folios. The patches make thp_underused() folio-size-aware, stop queuing folios for underused splitting when khugepaged/max_ptes_none is at its default maximum, and queue anonymous mTHP folios of at least 2M on the deferred split list.
